title: Citing a paper with both arXiv and L@S versions

entries.query_str: paper has arxiv v1 and later published at L@S 25 with slightly different numbers. which do i cite, and do i cite both
entries.answer:
Cite the **published (L@S '25) version** and use its numbers; that's the version of record [1]. Don't cite both as separate references — reviewers read that as padding, and it can look like two papers. Exceptions:
- If you specifically discuss something that **only appears in the preprint** (e.g., an analysis cut from the camera-ready), cite the arXiv version for that point and say so [1].
- In your `.bib`, keep **one entry** with the DOI; some people add the arXiv ID in a `note` or `eprint` field [2].

Also double-check any number you quote: if you copied it from the preprint (e.g., 0.69 macro-F1), update it to the camera-ready figure [2].
